intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The Twins' Clock Shop. Tri and Quad always played together. But the Metronome ticked them differently: Tri can only count in 3, and Quad can only count in 4.

intro.speaker: Tri
intro.text: One, two, three! One, two, three!

intro.speaker: Quad
intro.text: One, two, three, four! You're doing it wrong!

intro.speaker: Beats
intro.text: They're both ticked, and they're stuck fighting each other. You'll have to copy both rhythms at once.

intro.speaker: Clap
intro.text: Two rhythms. At the same time. Sure. Totally normal Tuesday.

win.speaker: Clap
win.text: Look, 3 and 4 both fit into 12. You were never really out of sync. You were playing a pattern together.

win.speaker: Tri
win.text: Hey, I can count to four now!

win.speaker: Quad
win.text: And I can count to three! Clap, go stop that tower. We'll be right behind you.

lose.speaker: Quad
lose.text: Off by one! Or by two! We can't agree which!

miss: Wrong count! And the other wrong count!
Even WE agree that was bad.
streak: Is it three or four? Don't tell us!
